_comment: Copy to profiles.json and edit. http:true => backend runs as ONE shared @playwright/mcp HTTP server per profile (multi-agent: several MCP clients share it). Omit http (or false) => classic stdio child per proxy. Each profile = one identity: userDataDir (ABSOLUTE, persistent, one browser at a time) OR isolated:true (ephemeral, unlimited parallel sessions). PIN the version (avoid @latest in prod). ntfyUrl (optional) = your NTFY topic for alerts (or PW_MCP_NTFY_URL env). Nothing hardcoded — only official @playwright/mcp documented flags (--user-data-dir/--isolated/--caps; --host/--port added by the supervisor).
_comment_maxBrowsers: OPTIONAL, ABSENT = UNLIMITED (recommended default). Max number of DISTINCT profiles served at the same time. Leave it out unless you have a reason: a running browser is one an agent is actively holding — the kernel refcount stops it the instant the last client lets go, so there are never idle browsers to reclaim. Set it only to cap a small machine. When the cap is reached a NEW profile is REFUSED with a named error; a running browser is NEVER evicted (evicting would kill work in progress). Joining an already-served profile is always allowed (sharing costs no extra browser). Read once when the daemon starts: changing it takes effect on the next daemon.
